Goelzer Investment Management Stake in Stericycle (SRCL) Boosted by $1.17 Million as Valuation Declined; Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) Shareholder Cibc World Markets Has Boosted Stake 
April 21, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Goelzer Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Stericycle Inc (SRCL) by 30.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goelzer Investment Management Inc bought 17,442 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.72% with the market. The institutional investor held 74,010 shares of the basic industries company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.03M, up from 56,568 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goelzer Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Stericycle Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.16B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.81% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $60.36. About 596,808 shares traded. Stericycle, Inc. (NASDAQ:SRCL) has declined 27.78% since April 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.33% the S&P500.
